Package net.sf.jguiraffe.examples.tutorial.model

Klasse DirectoryData

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.examples.tutorial.model.DirectoryData
public class DirectoryData extends Object

A data class for storing information about a directory.

Objects of this class are used by the file system browser to keep track about the directories already scanned. They are stored in the model of the tree view. Whenever a node in the tree is selected the corresponding DirectoryData object is determined. From this object the content of the directory can be obtained. It is also possible to find out whether this directory has already been read.
